classification.rationale: The Princess Costume Set is the first-named article. It is a GRI 3(b) set in which the long synthetic dress gives the essential character over the crown, belt and necklace. A well-made child's costume dress is wearing apparel, not a chapter 95 festive article, so it goes in heading 6104 when knit. NY H80172 (in force) classified a child's Princess Costume dress in 6104.43.2020 (girls' knit synthetic dress). The knit/woven construction and the separate Hippie Costume are open points.
